title: NovelAI text (novelai/text/spec/**/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under novelai/text/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to novelai/text/spec/ without .json is the spec id. When output is omitted, the saved filename is that id with .txt (nested folders preserved). When output is set, numbered files 001.txt, 002.txt, ... are written under that relative directory of novelai/text/output/ without overwriting, and existing numbered files are concatenated after input without separators as the story. Optional novelai/text/system_prompt.json, novelai/text/memory.json, and matching novelai/text/lorebook/ entries are prepended in that order, joined by blank lines, and sent as the single /ai/generate input. Lorebook files activate when the file stem or keys are a case-insensitive substring of that story. When omitted, model is llama-3-erato-v1 and max_length is 100. Trial accounts may only use kayra-v1. Tablet and Scroll cap max_length at 150; Opus at 250.

input.description: Opening story text. When output is set, numbered output files are concatenated after this without separators; that combined story is the search window for lorebook keys and is placed last in the assembled /ai/generate input, after system_prompt.json, memory.json, and matching lorebook entries. The saved file is the generated continuation, not this input.

model.description: NovelAI text model. When omitted, llama-3-erato-v1 is used.

max_length.description: Maximum generation length in tokens. When omitted, 100 is used.

output.description: Relative directory under novelai/text/output/ (or NOVELAI_TEXT_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY). Nested folders allowed. Absolute paths and .. are invalid. Existing numbered files 001.txt, 002.txt, ... are concatenated after input without separators. The new file is only this run's continuation and does not overwrite earlier numbers. When omitted, the saved filename is the spec id with .txt (nested folders preserved), overwritten each run.
